title: Round 4: photo-led, minimal type
question: Your new reference pinned the direction: the photograph carries the design, type stays quiet. Pick a variant; hero stand-ins are flat colour until Higgsfield art arrives.

options.label: Photo Haze
options.lineage: your reference: dusk apron, text floating in open sky
options.thesis: A full-bleed warm-haze photograph with the title set small and still in the empty sky.
options.viewport: Photo edge to edge, 70px title in the sky, a thin top bar of tiny labels, team names bottom left.
options.risk: Text legibility depends on the photo keeping a quiet sky area; Higgsfield must leave that region empty.

options.label: Photo Night
options.thesis: The same system in the dark: white type low-left over a deep blue photograph.
options.viewport: Photo edge to edge, 96px white title bottom left, thin top bar.
options.risk: Dark slides wash out on a bright classroom projector.

options.label: Photo Panel
options.lineage: photograph beside a quiet text panel
options.thesis: Title slides keep a photo; the left panel becomes the template for data slides with figures.
options.viewport: 520px off-white panel with the title, photo fills the right 60%.
options.risk: Less cinematic than full-bleed, but the safest on a projector and for dense slides.
